entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sordland One's flight from Holsord..."
entries.dialogueText: Sordland One's flight from Holsord to Wraclawitz took approximately five hours. Despite heavy turbulence, I managed to sleep a little.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon, Deivid and I landed at the i..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon, Deivid and I landed at the international airport of the capital city of Wehlen. Our aim here was to finalise the trade deal drafted between Sordland and Wehlen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our plane landed, and the door open..."
entries.dialogueText: Our plane landed, and the door opened. The sun blinded me for a moment. I stepped outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw the soldiers lined up on eith..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw the soldiers lined up on either side of a red carpet. There must've been at least a hundred of them. A marching band started playing and the soldiers immediately saluted me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nice to see you, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Nice to see you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted the soldiers."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted the soldiers.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I walked downstairs and proceeded w..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked downstairs and proceeded without any gestures.
entries.menuText: Proceed to the red carpet without any gestures.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the bottom of the stairs, Wiktor..."
entries.dialogueText: At the bottom of the stairs, Wiktor Smolak was waiting for me next to a military jeep with a few soldiers by his side. There were a few reporters at the edge of the crowd, waiting with their cameras.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was a tall man, almost as tall a..."
entries.dialogueText: He was a tall man, almost as tall as me. He was wearing large sunglasses and a regular suit, contrasting with the military attire of everyone else in the field.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Mr. President. Welcome to Wraclawi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Welcome to Wraclawitz.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He immediately motioned for an embr..."
entries.dialogueText: He immediately motioned for an embrace. We hugged and many cameras went off at the same time. He turned around for a couple of additional poses.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for inviting us.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for inviting us.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pulled him aside for a couple of..."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled him aside for a couple of more poses.
entries.menuText: Pull him aside for a couple of more poses yourself.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Now that the pleasantries are done..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now that the pleasantries are done, let's go! We will take the jeep for a tour.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With another tune from the marching..."
entries.dialogueText: With another tune from the marching band, we boarded the military jeep. He sat in the driver's seat and I sat next to him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we started speeding up, the sold..."
entries.dialogueText: As we started speeding up, the soldiers saluted again. Wiktor saluted back.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted the soldiers."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted the soldiers.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I did nothing.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“We will first go to the city cente..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will first go to the city center to see the unveiling of a statue.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both of our security details starte..."
entries.dialogueText: Both of our security details started following us immediately, along with a team of reporters.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Whose statue?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Whose statue?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sounds ...exciting.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sounds ...exciting.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd rather not waste time. Let's g..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'd rather not waste time. Let's get straight to business.”
entries.menuText: “I'd rather not waste time. Let's get straight to business.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Ah, Mr. President. I must insist...."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah, Mr. President. I must insist. Also, I am in the driver's seat.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“This is an important occasion for..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is an important occasion for Wehlen. I am sure you will like it.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Mine, of course.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mine, of course.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We kept making small talk about the..."
entries.dialogueText: We kept making small talk about the flight and the weather as we made our way towards the city center.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On almost every corner, there were..."
entries.dialogueText: On almost every corner, there were reporters taking photos of us. Aside from them, though, the streets seemed completely empty.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is Wraclawitz always this empty?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Is Wraclawitz always this empty?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is this all a big photo op for you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Is this all a big photo op for you?”
entries.menuText: “Is this all a big photo op for you?”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I had this part of the city close..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had this part of the city close down because of your visit so that you could enjoy the city in peace.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“It is a good opportunity to show t..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is a good opportunity to show the world our unity in Eastern Merkopa. We must display our unified strength to Rumburg.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How long is this going to take?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How long is this going to take?”
entries.menuText: “How long is this going to take?”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Patience is a virtue. We will be d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Patience is a virtue. We will be done soon, and then we can discuss our trade deal.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“There we are.”"
entries.dialogueText: “There we are.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We arrived at the center. In the mi..."
entries.dialogueText: We arrived at the center. In the middle of a large plaza, there was a covered statue. Large crowds of people were gathered behind fences. waving both Sordland and Wehlen flags. Wiktor waved back at them.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“My people have been very supportiv..."
entries.dialogueText: “My people have been very supportive of this visit, Mr. President. I am sure you are delighted to see them.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A man came closer to the fences and..."
entries.dialogueText: A man came closer to the fences and started yelling at Wiktor. With my limited knowledge of the Wehzek language, I understood the words 'Wiktor' and 'murderer'.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Almost instantaneously, two soldier..."
entries.dialogueText: Almost instantaneously, two soldiers came up from behind the man and he was taken away.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Thankfully the sun is out. Today w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thankfully the sun is out. Today will be a good day for the reveal.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I see that you know how to handle..."
entries.dialogueText: “I see that you know how to handle dissidents. Very good.”
entries.menuText: “I see that you know how to handle dissidents. Very good.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What will happen to the man who wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “What will happen to the man who was protesting you?”
entries.menuText: “What will happen to the man who was protesting you?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very good.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Oh, which man? That one in the cro..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, which man? That one in the crowd?”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Don't worry about the details. He..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't worry about the details. He must've been a troubled fellow. Let's focus on the event.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I am glad you approve. We are of t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am glad you approve. We are of the same mind.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“See, I knew we would get along fin..."
entries.dialogueText: “See, I knew we would get along fine.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Let's take our places.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's take our places.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We took our places in front of the..."
entries.dialogueText: We took our places in front of the statue. With a drumroll, the statue of Wiktor Smolak was uncovered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a fairly good likeness, albe..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a fairly good likeness, albeit more muscular than the real Wiktor. He was wearing a cloak and holding a sword in his hand.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Excellent statue. Very lifelike. W..."
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent statue. Very lifelike. What do you think?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our artists can do better in Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our artists can do better in Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “Our artists can do better in Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, it's very good. Very lifelike..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, it's very good. Very lifelike.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Mr. Smolak, I don't have time for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Smolak, I don't have time for these games. Let's get straight to the business.”
entries.menuText: “Mr. Smolak, I don't have time for these games. Let's get straight to the business.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Don't worry. We will.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Don't worry. We will.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Glad you appreciate the art behind..."
entries.dialogueText: “Glad you appreciate the art behind it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face soured."
entries.dialogueText: His face soured.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Well...then I'd like to contact on..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well...then I'd like to contact one.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to the soldiers and start..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to the soldiers and started yelling at them in Wehzek. The soldiers covered the statue again.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Join me for a walk.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Join me for a walk.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I followed him through the streets...."
entries.dialogueText: I followed him through the streets. At every corner, more and more photos were taken.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stopped in front of a pastry ven..."
entries.dialogueText: We stopped in front of a pastry vendor on the street.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Give me two strudels.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Give me two strudels.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The man behind the stand smiled and..."
entries.dialogueText: The man behind the stand smiled and gave us two strudels.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I put my hand on my wallet and brou..."
entries.dialogueText: I put my hand on my wallet and brought up some money to give the vendor.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you going to pay for it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are you going to pay for it?”
entries.menuText: “Are you going to pay for it?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I waited for him to pay the street..."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for him to pay the street vendor. He simply took the two strudels and didn't pay anything.
entries.menuText: Wait for him to pay the street vendor.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Of course, Mr. Rayne! Smolak's got..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, Mr. Rayne! Smolak's got your back!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Hold up. Your money doesn't count..."
entries.dialogueText: “Hold up. Your money doesn't count here. I got this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He handed the money to the street v..."
entries.dialogueText: He handed the money to the street vendor with a huge smile on his face. The cameras flashed again.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I kept walking alongside Wiktor."
entries.dialogueText: I kept walking alongside Wiktor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Afterwards, we walked a short dista..."
entries.dialogueText: Afterwards, we walked a short distance to the palace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Passing the gates, we made our way..."
entries.dialogueText: Passing the gates, we made our way into the main building made from ivory-colored stones. The old guard towers flanked the magnificent structure from both sides.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The inside of the palace was very s..."
entries.dialogueText: The inside of the palace was very spacious, with a very large chandelier hanging from the ceiling. Grand staircases made from the same ivory stone had red carpets on them. On the upper levels, guards stood wearing the traditional outfits of the old Wehzek kingdom.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We finally reached the office of th..."
entries.dialogueText: We finally reached the office of the President of Wehlen. The door closed behind us. I looked around at the golden ornaments on the walls and the various jewel-encrusted artifacts.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As it was customary in Wehlen, we s..."
entries.dialogueText: As it was customary in Wehlen, we sat down on the carpet.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Now we can talk about our trade de..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now we can talk about our trade deal.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Finally.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Finally.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“But before that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “But before that.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He clapped his hands twice."
entries.dialogueText: He clapped his hands twice.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Bring the Khisha.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Bring the Khisha.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few assistants immediately entere..."
entries.dialogueText: A few assistants immediately entered the room, carrying a large ornamented Khisha, the well-known smoking instrument originating from Wehlen. They immediately lit it up and the room was filled with the smell of tobacco.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor inhaled the smoke and handed..."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor inhaled the smoke and handed me the Khisha.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I inhaled the smoke."
entries.dialogueText: I inhaled the smoke.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't smoke.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I don't smoke.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Your loss. It's the finest tobacco..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your loss. It's the finest tobacco in the land.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“So... Mr. President. Bah, that's t..."
entries.dialogueText: “So... Mr. President. Bah, that's too long. Can I call you Anton?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took another puff, filling the r..."
entries.dialogueText: He took another puff, filling the room with more smoke.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I prefer my official title.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I prefer my official title.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sure.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sure.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Very well, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Anton.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Tell me. What do you really think..."
entries.dialogueText: “Tell me. What do you really think about Rumburg?”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I know you have put an embargo on..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know you have put an embargo on Rumburg, and I congratulate you for standing up to them. But let me ask you a question. What do you really think about Rumburg?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are a threat to the region.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They are a threat to the region.”
entries.menuText: “They are a threat to the region.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A barking dog doesn't bite.”"
entries.dialogueText: “A barking dog doesn't bite.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They can go to hell!”"
entries.dialogueText: “They can go to hell!”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Exactly! To hell with Rumburg! I l..."
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly! To hell with Rumburg! I like you already, Anton!”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I agree with your sentiments, Anto..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree with your sentiments, Anton. They are a threat to everyone in the region.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I wouldn't be so sure, Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't be so sure, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I wouldn't be so sure, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't be so sure, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I assure you their time will come...."
entries.dialogueText: “I assure you their time will come.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you planning something?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are you planning something?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“In due time, yes.”"
entries.dialogueText: “In due time, yes.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Regardless, I would rather prevent..."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless, I would rather prevent further conflict in the region.”
entries.menuText: “Regardless, I would rather prevent further conflict in the region.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Well...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well...”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Not yet.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Not yet.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“First, I need to solve some proble..."
entries.dialogueText: “First, I need to solve some problems they are creating for me.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“You know as well as I do, Anton. T..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know as well as I do, Anton. They are coming whether we like it or not. They are the aggressor, not us.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“You know as well as I do, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know as well as I do, Mr. President. They are coming whether we like it or not. They are the aggressor, not us.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Not much in particular. Like any o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not much in particular. Like any other country, they have their needs and their own agenda.”
entries.menuText: “Not much in particular. Like any other country, they have their needs and their own agenda.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Yes, they do. But their ambitions..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, they do. But their ambitions are over Wehlen and Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Exactly! To hell with Rumburg! I l..."
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly! To hell with Rumburg! I like you already, Mr. President!”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I agree with your sentiments, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree with your sentiments, Mr. President. They are a threat to everyone in the region.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“We must be careful, Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We must be careful, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“We must be careful, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: “We must be careful, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What is it?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm listening.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm listening.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He clapped his hands again. Two ass..."
entries.dialogueText: He clapped his hands again. Two assistants came into the room with a map of the border regions between Wehlen and Sordland. He pointed at the border.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Look.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Look.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Bluds and their so called *BFF* ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “Bluds and their so called *BFF* are causing problems for me in this region. They are getting increasingly dangerous with Rumburg's active support. I know that they are a problem for you as well.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I will not allow these traitors to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will not allow these traitors to exist within my borders. So I will hit them with all the might of Wehlen. These terrorists need to be destroyed.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I call it Operation Bear Trap.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I call it Operation Bear Trap.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't support any military actio..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't support any military action this close to our borders.”
entries.menuText: “I don't support any military action this close to our borders.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What do you want from me?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What do you want from me?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I like the sound of it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I like the sound of it.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Here is the deal. I will give you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Here is the deal. I will give you objectively the *best* trade deal in the region.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grinned and lay back on the larg..."
entries.dialogueText: He grinned and lay back on the large pillow behind him.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“You will give me your assistance c..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will give me your assistance crushing the terrorists on both of our borders.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lay back on the large pillow beh..."
entries.dialogueText: He lay back on the large pillow behind him.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I need specifics.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I need specifics.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Absolutely not. I won't meddle in..."
entries.dialogueText: “Absolutely not. I won't meddle in Wehlen's military interventions.”
entries.menuText: “Absolutely not. I won't meddle in Wehlen's military interventions.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Two birds, one stone.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Two birds, one stone.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“You read my mind.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You read my mind.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“This is not just Wehlen's problem...."
entries.dialogueText: “This is not just Wehlen's problem. This is also Sordland's problem. These terrorists are doing anything they can to destabilize the region.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Sure.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sure.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“My spies have infiltrated BFF cell..."
entries.dialogueText: “My spies have infiltrated BFF cells and they found caches of KA-74s. We traced them back to Rumburg. This alone justifies my retaliation to protect my country!”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Worst of all, we also found that s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Worst of all, we also found that similar shipments are going to Sordland. Rumburg is trying to unite the BFF forces in both of our countries.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Yes, Anton. You see. This is not j..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, Anton. You see. This is not just Wehlen's problem.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Yes, Mr. President. You see. This..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, Mr. President. You see. This is not just Wehlen's problem.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Let's take a step back and talk ab..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's take a step back and talk about what you will get in return.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I propose you a no-tariff agreemen..."
entries.dialogueText: “I propose you a no-tariff agreement, co-investment projects and oil.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“You know that as long as they use..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know that as long as they use the mountains in Wehlen as a base, Sordland and Lespia will equally suffer. This is in the interest of the whole region.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What kind of support do you need f..."
entries.dialogueText: “What kind of support do you need from me? Can't Wehlen handle it by itself?”
entries.menuText: “What kind of support do you need from me? Can't Wehlen handle it by itself?”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“We can, but these vermin are good..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can, but these vermin are good at hiding. As I told you, they operate and keep reorganizing inside both of our countries.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“There might be international ramif..."
entries.dialogueText: “There might be international ramifications.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“To hell with international ramific..."
entries.dialogueText: “To hell with international ramifications! I will protect my country! I don't care what they say!”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“What I want from you in return for..."
entries.dialogueText: “What I want from you in return for all the money and the resources, is only a joint operation between our armies against the BFF.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Deal.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Deal.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a moment to think about it."
entries.dialogueText: I took a moment to think about it.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No deal. It's too risky. I'm afrai..."
entries.dialogueText: “No deal. It's too risky. I'm afraid I can't accept.”
entries.menuText: “No deal. It's too risky. I'm afraid I can't accept.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's negotiate Sordland's contrib..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's negotiate Sordland's contribution in this operation.”
entries.menuText: “Let's negotiate Sordland's contribution in this operation.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“You are a tough one, Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You are a tough one, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“You are a tough one, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are a tough one, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Wait, Mr. President. Wait.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Wait, Mr. President. Wait.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Wait, Anton. Wait.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Wait, Anton. Wait.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I knew I could trust you, Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I knew I could trust you, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“I knew I could trust you, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “I knew I could trust you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Normally, I wouldn't offer anythin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Normally, I wouldn't offer anything else but, I like you.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Here is my final offer.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Here is my final offer.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“When the operation starts, with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “When the operation starts, with you or without you, there will be stragglers trying to cross into Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“We just want you to support the op..."
entries.dialogueText: “We just want you to support the operation even if you do not join. Stop the terrorists from fleeing into your country and you will have your deal. Simple, isn't it?”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“So what do you think?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So what do you think?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No deal. I'm afraid I can't accept..."
entries.dialogueText: “No deal. I'm afraid I can't accept.”
entries.menuText: “No deal. I'm afraid I can't accept.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“That's unfortunate. I thought we c..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's unfortunate. I thought we could be friends.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“But you decided to leave Wehlen to..."
entries.dialogueText: “But you decided to leave Wehlen to fend for itself.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Such a shame. I am sure a powerful..."
entries.dialogueText: “Such a shame. I am sure a powerful leader like Soll would've accepted this great offer without a doubt.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Tonight we will drink!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Tonight we will drink!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He clapped his hands again."
entries.dialogueText: He clapped his hands again.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Drinks! Dancers! Music!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Drinks! Dancers! Music!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Instead of the two assistants this..."
entries.dialogueText: Instead of the two assistants this time, a group of dancers and performers entered. Smoke filled  the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As they performed their songs, we c..."
entries.dialogueText: As they performed their songs, we clinked our glasses to our new partnership while sipping the sweet Wehzek liquor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next day, I returned to Sordlan..."
entries.dialogueText: The next day, I returned to Sordland with a hangover.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“My assistants will show you the wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “My assistants will show you the way.”

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: "“Goodbye, Mr. Rayne.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye, Mr. Rayne.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Take care of yourself, Wiktor.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Take care of yourself, Wiktor.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded and left."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded and left.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I returned to Sordland immediately."
entries.dialogueText: I returned to Sordland immediately.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt relieved to be back in Holso..."
entries.dialogueText: I felt relieved to be back in Holsord.

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""However, the main problem is the b..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the main problem is the border security between our nations. BFF militants have been using the mountains between Sordland and Wehlen to escape justice in both of our countries."

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak: ""If we don't act and trap them in t..."
